title: SKE CL2000 Mad Citrus Tart Prefilled Pod + Refill - 20mg
description: Med Citrus Tart combines warm Pastry notes with a tangy Citrus filling for a simple, satisfying bakery‑style vape. Each CL2000 replacement pack contains a 1.8ml prefilled pod and a 2.2ml refill container. Click them together, fit to your CL2000 device and enjoy consistent flavour from the mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt e‑liquid, with up to 2000 puffs per pack depending on use. To replace: remove seals, click the pod and refill together, then push the assembled unit into the device until it locks. When both sections are empty, dispose of them responsibly and fit a fresh CL2000 pod + refill.
